title: Yummy Fluffy Neapolitan Dried-Shrimp-Goong-Haeng Orecchiette
description: A citrusy, fluffy Neapolitan dish featuring dried-shrimp-goong-haeng, slow-cooked to perfection and served with orecchiette pasta. This energizing dish is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: dried shrimp-goong-haeng
ingredients.notes: rehydrated in 150ml of hot water for 30 minutes

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: for saut9ing the garlic and dried shrimp-goong-haeng

instructions: Rehydrate the dried shrimp-goong-haeng in 150ml of hot water for 30 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Cook the orecchiette pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saut6 the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the rehydrated dried shrimp-goong-haeng to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the lemon juice and butter to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the butter has melted and the mixture is well combined.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the garlic and dried shrimp-goong-haeng mixture until well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.
Garnish with the zest of 1 lemon and serve immediately.
